title: Parental Leave Income Gap
description: Port of ApexLogics Apex #131 (AL-138) Parental Leave Income Gap Planner into the AINumbers chaingraph shape. From an annual base salary, an effective tax rate, monthly household and baby expenses, partner monthly take-home, current savings, an employer paid/partial leave structure, a state PFL/SDI program (2025-vintage rate and weekly cap), a PFL duration and a total leave duration, the node computes the week-by-week leave schedule (employer pay by phase, haircut state benefit, partner pass-through, 1.05x-of-net no-windfall cap, net per week), the total income gap (sum of negative weekly nets), average monthly leave income, monthly shortfall, savings needed, and post-return recovery months (finite ceil of gap over surplus, or the 999 display sentinel when surplus is non-positive, distinguished by recovery_finite). Verdict bands at covered and half-covered. Out-of-domain inputs are refused by throw with a named REFUSED_BAD_* reason (the Apex page silently substituted falsy defaults; the seven declared divergences are pinned by fixtures BF-T1..T7). State rates/caps are the Apex 2025 schedule kept verbatim for fixture parity; the official 2026 schedules differ on every state row (payload DIFFERS D1-D6, CITES G1-G6) and the L351 half-rate benefit haircut is UNGROUNDED (CITES U2); every output carries the vintage and grounding flags. Port provenance: Apex page https://apexlogics.org/tools/131-parental-leave-income-gap/ fetched 2026-10-13 (sha256 ddd140c288a9219c6873ad1c54fe724d271e81dfa4216014b1da4cc5a0ec3001), tasking APEXPORT-131 (GRADES PASS-PENDING-XV 2026-10-18, Builder-verifies-at-land 35/35 vectors), landed by APEX-PORT-131-LAND-1 on 2026-10-20.

base_salary.description: Annual base salary in dollars (gross); drives weekly gross/net and the state PFL base (Apex L122/L344).

tax_rate_pct.description: Effective tax rate as a PERCENT; divided by 100 internally. Net pay is haircut fully, the state benefit at half rate (ungrounded assumption U2).

monthly_expenses.description: Monthly household expenses in dollars, before baby expense (Apex L130).

partner_income.description: Partner/spouse monthly take-home income in dollars; steady through leave and after return (Apex L136).

savings.description: Current savings in dollars; compared against the gap, never drawn down arithmetically (Apex L140).

employer_paid_weeks.description: Employer-paid leave weeks at full net pay, starting week 1 (Apex L150).

employer_partial_weeks.description: Employer partial-pay weeks immediately after the full-pay weeks (Apex L153).

employer_partial_pct.description: Employer partial-pay rate as a PERCENT of net weekly pay; divided by 100 internally (Apex L158).

state_program.description: State PFL/SDI program selector; rates/caps use the Apex 2025 schedule (kernel STATE_PFL_RATES_2025 / STATE_CAPS_WEEKLY_2025).

state_pfl_weeks.description: State PFL/SDI duration in weeks, concurrent from week 1 (Apex L177).

custom_pfl_rate_pct.description: Custom state PFL wage-replacement rate as a PERCENT, used only when state_program is custom; divided by 100 internally (Apex L181).

total_leave_weeks.description: Total leave duration in weeks including FMLA unpaid weeks; drives the schedule loop (Apex L187).

baby_expense.description: New recurring monthly baby expense in dollars (diapers, formula, nursery), starting month 1 (Apex L190).

mcp_tool_definition.name: parental_leave_income_gap
mcp_tool_definition.description: Week-by-week parental-leave income schedule stacking employer paid/partial leave, state PFL/SDI and partner income against household expenses: total income gap, average monthly income during leave, monthly shortfall, savings needed to cover the gap, and post-return recovery months. State rates/caps are the Apex 2025 schedule. Refuses out-of-domain inputs by name rather than silently substituting defaults.

tax_rate_pct.description: Effective tax rate as a PERCENT; divided by 100 internally. Net pay is haircut fully, the state benefit at half rate (ungrounded assumption U2).

savings.description: Current savings in dollars; compared against the gap, never drawn down arithmetically (Apex L140).

employer_partial_weeks.description: Employer partial-pay weeks immediately after the full-pay weeks (Apex L153).

employer_partial_pct.description: Employer partial-pay rate as a PERCENT of net weekly pay; divided by 100 internally (Apex L158).

state_program.description: State PFL/SDI program selector; rates/caps use the Apex 2025 schedule (kernel STATE_PFL_RATES_2025 / STATE_CAPS_WEEKLY_2025).

state_pfl_weeks.description: State PFL/SDI duration in weeks, concurrent from week 1 (Apex L177).

baby_expense.description: New recurring monthly baby expense in dollars (diapers, formula, nursery), starting month 1 (Apex L190).

total_gap.description: Total income gap: sum of |net| over weeks with negative net (Apex L376/L384).

avg_leave_monthly.description: Average monthly income during leave: (total income / leave weeks) x 4.333 (Apex L382).

savings_needed.description: Savings needed to cover the gap; equals total_gap (Apex L384).

recovery_months.description: ceil(savings_needed / surplus_per_month) when surplus is positive, else the 999 display sentinel (Apex L390).

recovery_finite.description: True when post-return surplus per month is positive; distinguishes the 999 sentinel from a duration.

verdict.description: Covered reads positive; above half the gap reads warn; at or below half reads danger (Apex L411-414).

state_pfl_rate.description: Applied PFL wage-replacement rate (custom rate or the 2025-vintage state row, Apex L349).

state_pfl_weekly.description: min(gross x rate, cap) x (1 - tax_rate x 0.5) (Apex L351; UNGROUNDED haircut).

state_cap.description: Applied weekly benefit cap, 99999 fallback for the none row (Apex L350).

state_cap_binds.description: Diagnostic: gross x rate >= cap (Apex L351).

return_monthly_net.description: Post-return monthly net: (base_salary / 12) x (1 - tax_rate) (Apex L388).

surplus_per_month.description: max(0, return net + partner income - expenses - baby expense) (Apex L389).

rows.description: Week-by-week schedule: week, phase, emp_pay, state_pfl, partner, total_in, expenses, net, windfall_capped.

compliance_flags.description: Vintage, grounding, cap-binding and sentinel flags carried on every output.

input_schema_provenance: Each property is exactly the policy_parameters member the kernel reads; there is no other input surface, and every property is required: the kernel refuses any missing or out-of-domain input by throw (DIFFERS D10; the Apex page substituted falsy defaults). Minima and maxima mirror the Apex page control attributes, Apex L122-L193. State rates/caps are the Apex 2025-vintage schedule (payload DIFFERS D1-D6).
